script.editorDescription: Write and arrange the scenes for “{{name}}”.
script.charactersPlaceholder: Describe recurring characters, clothing, and props to keep consistent.

render.title: Render
render.loadError: Could not load the render status.

headline.failedMerge: The scenes could not be merged

render.order: Scenes render one after another, then they are merged.
render.leaveNote: You can leave this page. Progress also shows under Tasks.
render.noAccounts: No enabled account has a verified session. Test an account first.

start.description: Scenes render one after another from scene 1, then they are merged into one video. You can leave the page; progress also shows under Tasks.
start.locked: The script cannot be edited once rendering starts.

cancel.title: Cancel the render?
cancel.description: The scene being generated stops and the scenes that have not run are cancelled. Finished scenes are kept, and you can continue later.

resume.title: Send the interrupted scene again?
resume.description: The app stopped after this scene was sent to Muse, so it may already have been generated there. Sending it again can use quota a second time.

errors.render_not_ready: This project cannot start rendering right now. Reload it and try again.
errors.account_unavailable: No enabled account has a verified session. Test an account, then try again.
errors.render_not_active: Nothing is rendering for this project any more.
errors.render_not_resumable: There is no stopped render to continue.
errors.confirm_required: A scene may already have been sent to Muse. Confirm to send it again.
errors.render_not_restartable: This scene cannot be rendered again right now. Every earlier scene needs a clip first.
errors.unknown: The request failed. Please try again.

restart.title: Render again from scene {{number}}?
restart.range: Scenes {{number}}–{{count}} are rendered again so they stay connected.
restart.cost: The current clips of those scenes and the merged video are replaced, each new scene uses Muse quota, and a new conversation is started on Muse.

settings.title: Edit project
settings.description: The name, idea, ratio and duration can change until a render starts. The render options also apply when you render again.
settings.lockedBrief: This project has been rendered, so only the render options can change.
settings.durationWithScript: The saved script is written for {{seconds}} seconds.
settings.discardScript: Delete the current script so the duration can change

lookHints.auto: Adds nothing: the look comes from the visual style written in the script.
lookHints.realistic: Asks for real-camera footage: natural skin and light, no CGI or plastic look.
lookHints.cinematic: Film look: anamorphic lens, graded color, deliberate camera moves.
lookHints.documentary: Handheld camera, available light, candid moments.
lookHints.commercial: Clean studio lighting, crisp detail, polished grade.
lookHints.animation3d: Stylized 3D characters with soft lighting and rich textures.
lookHints.anime: Line art, cel shading and painted backgrounds.

continuityHints.reference: The last frame of the previous scene is attached as a reference for characters, wardrobe and color. Scenes may still cut to a new place.
continuityHints.seamless: Each scene starts exactly on the last frame of the previous one. Best for one continuous location; cuts to a new place look forced.
continuityHints.off: Each scene is generated from its prompt alone.

errors.project_busy: This project is rendering. Cancel the render or wait for it to finish.
errors.project_locked: A render has started, so only the render options can change now.
errors.duration_locked: The script is written for the current duration. Tick the box to delete it, or keep the duration.
errors.unknown: The changes could not be saved. Please try again.

settings.languageHint: Used for scene titles, narration and anything spoken in the video.
settings.muteHint: Muse is asked for silent scenes and the merged video has no sound. On a finished project this merges the video again; nothing is rendered again.

studio.title: Studio
studio.noClip: The picture appears here once this scene is rendered.

accounts.verificationNote: Test verifies the session. Keep alive refreshes it and checks the workspace. Quota reads the latest usage; unknown data stays unfilled until checked.

empty.title: Connect your first Muse account
empty.description: Import a session from your Muse account to start setting up your workspace.
empty.noResultsDescription: Try another label or clear the current filters.

import.title: Import a Muse account
import.description: Paste a session from your Muse account. Use Test after importing to verify it.
import.cookieHint: Paste cookies in any form you copied them: a Cookie header, document.cookie, request headers, Copy as cURL or fetch, a cookie extension's JSON export, or cookies.txt. Other sites' cookies are ignored. hatch_sess is required. This form is cleared when closed.

rename.title: Rename account
rename.description: Choose a label that helps you recognize this account.

delete.title: Delete this account?
delete.description: The saved session for “{{label}}” will be permanently removed. Your video projects will stay unchanged.

confirm.title: Send this request again?
confirm.description: The app stopped after this request reached Muse, so Muse may have already produced a result. Sending it again can create a duplicate and use more quota. Check the conversation on Muse first.
confirm.cancelDescription: Queued work stops immediately. Running work stops as soon as its current step allows; a request already sent to Muse may continue there.
confirm.retryDescription: This queues another run using the original input. Review the error and fix any account or proxy issues first.
confirm.duplicateWarning: The earlier request may already exist in Muse. Running it again can create duplicate work and use additional quota.
confirm.accountNote: Automatic selection clears the assignment. Work waits if no eligible account is available, and the same account may be selected again.
confirm.stateChanged: The task status changed. Close this dialog to review the latest state.

details.title: Task details
details.submitted: This request was sent to Muse.
details.description: Check the latest status, account, and outcome.
details.missingDescription: This task is no longer available. Close this panel to return to the list.
details.scriptReady: Script generation completed. Open the project to review its current script and latest proposal.

empty.title: No tasks yet
empty.description: Script generation and other Muse requests appear here while they run.

tasks.loadError: Could not load tasks. Check the connection and try again.

errors.task_not_retryable: Only failed, interrupted, or cancelled tasks can be retried.
errors.confirm_required: This task may already have reached Muse. Confirm before sending it again.
errors.project_not_found: The project for this task no longer exists.
errors.script_conflict: The project's script changed since this task started. Start a new generation from the project.
errors.generation_active: Another script generation is already running for this project.
errors.account_unavailable: The account is disabled or its session is not verified. Test the account, then retry.
errors.account_deleted: The account for this task was deleted. Retry with another account.
errors.session_invalid: The account's login session expired. Re-import its cookies, then retry.
errors.proxy_error: The account's proxy failed. Check the proxy settings, then retry.
errors.access_denied: Muse refused the request (HTTP 403). Check the account and its network route.
errors.rate_limited: Muse received too many requests. This usually clears after a few minutes.
errors.network_error: Could not reach Muse. Check the server's network connection.
errors.upstream_timeout: Muse did not answer in time.
errors.browser_unavailable: Chromium is not available on the server.
errors.browser_busy: The browser is busy. Wait for the current operation to finish before trying again.
errors.reply_timeout: Muse did not finish replying in time. Check the conversation on Muse before retrying.
errors.composer_unavailable: The Muse chat box could not be used. Try again later.
errors.workspace_not_running: The Muse workspace is not running.
errors.wake_failed: Muse refused to wake the workspace.
errors.account_changed: The account changed while this task ran. Retry to use its current session.
errors.invalid_script: Muse replied, but not with a usable script. Try again.
errors.generation_browser_error: The browser failed while talking to Muse.
errors.interrupted: The app stopped after this request was sent to Muse. Check the result before retrying.
errors.internal_error: The task failed because of an internal error.
errors.unknown_kind: This app version cannot run this kind of task.
errors.dependency_failed: An earlier step failed, so this one did not run.
errors.network: Could not reach the server. Check the connection and try again.
errors.load: Could not refresh tasks. Any visible data may be out of date.
errors.loadMore: Could not load more tasks. Your loaded tasks are still available.
errors.quota_exhausted: The account ran out of Muse quota. Continue with another account or wait for the weekly reset.
errors.generation_timeout: Muse did not deliver the video in time. Check the conversation on Muse before retrying.
errors.generation_refused: Muse replied without a video. Review the prompt of the scene, then retry.
errors.media_download_failed: The video was generated but could not be downloaded. Retry the scene.
errors.scene_missing: The clip of a scene is missing, so the video could not be merged.
errors.ffmpeg_unavailable: FFmpeg is not installed on the server, so the scenes could not be merged. Install it, then continue.
errors.merge_failed: FFmpeg could not merge the scenes.
errors.reference_upload_failed: The frame of the previous scene could not be attached, so nothing was sent to Muse. Retry, or turn continuity off in the project settings.
errors.reference_frame_failed: The last frame of the previous scene could not be read. Retry, or render again from that scene.

tasks.autoUpdate: Updates every 5 seconds while this tab is visible. Progress is shown only when reported by Muse.
tasks.attentionDescription: Review failed or interrupted tasks before deciding what to run again.

suggestions.retry: Review the issue, then run the task again when ready.
suggestions.relogin: Update the account cookies and test the session before running again.
suggestions.switch_account: Check account availability or choose automatic account selection when running again.
suggestions.check_proxy: Check the account proxy and test the connection before running again.
